title: Talented artist J BOOTH releases an anticipated single titled "Somewhere"
htmlContent:
American-based artist J BOOTH is again making waves with the release of his latest track, "Somewhere." J BOOTH is a multi-talented singer and songwriter currently putting his listeners at the edge of their seats, producing works that fuse multiple genres.

J BOOTH's "Somewhere" is a musical master class that shines with its unique approach to give you all you could want from a record and more. The music feels good to hear, to the point that you listen as a fan for every second, with a must-hear sound that makes you leave your subjectivity at the door.
